hanging.line: They're selling postcards of the hanging
stanza: They're selling postcards of the hanging

hanging.line: How the Lizzies, how's your Jesus Christ been hanging?
stanza: Father Lucifer you never looked so sane

How the Lizzies, how's your Jesus Christ been hanging?
